liebermann.notes: A pontifical of c. 1140, belonging to Hereford in 1348, containing Iudicium Dei XI–XIV (ff. 209v–217), the Duel (added c. 1250, f. 243) and a Consecratio regis with the Sacramentum coronationis (f. 99). Most closely related to Tr and Vt 2.

entries.text_de:
Oxford Magdalen College 226, Pontifical um 1140, gehörte 1348 Hereford, enthält f. 209b. 211. 211b. 217 Iud Dei XI. XII. XIII. XIV, unten S. 419 bis 427.

F. 243 um 1250 nachgetragen Duel, u. S. 430.

Der Band enthält auch f. 99 Consecratio regis mit Sacr cor, u. S. 215.

Nächstverwandt mit Tr und Vt 2.
entries.text_en:
Oxford, Magdalen College 226, pontifical c. 1140, belonged in 1348 to Hereford, contains, f. 209b. 211. 211b. 217, Iud Dei XI. XII. XIII. XIV, below, pp. 419 to 427.

F. 243, added c. 1250, Duel, below, p. 430.

The volume also contains, f. 99, Consecratio regis with Sacr cor, below, p. 215.

Most closely related to Tr and Vt 2.

notes.text_de: Das Mg verwandte Anglonorm. Pontifical im Trinity College zu Dublin enthält keine Ordalformeln. Freundl. Mitth. von Rev. H. A. Wilson (nach Dr. Lawlor zu Dublin), November 1901.
notes.text_en: The Anglo-Norman pontifical related to Mg in Trinity College, Dublin, contains no ordeal formulae. Kind communication from Rev. H. A. Wilson (after Dr Lawlor of Dublin), November 1901.

transcription.doubts: A stray raised dot between 'gehörte' and '1348' is a printing blemish, omitted. Entry runs from col. 1 into col. 2.
